instruction: Export all my Simple Note notes to "~/backups/simple_notes/" directory in my file system. The files should be named according to the note title, replacing white space with "_", and the extension should be ".md".
notes: The number of notes is only known at runtime, so the problem uses three representative note objects (note-1..note-3); instantiate one note/content/file-path triple per note returned by simple_note.search_notes (all pages). Each note needs simple_note.show_note (content) and file_system.create_file (write ~/backups/simple_notes/<title with spaces as _>.md). Because STRIPS has no quantified goals, 'all notes exported' is tracked with a static enumeration chain (next-note) ending in the domain constant no-more-notes: create_file for note n requires (all-exported-before n) and asserts (all-exported-before next), so (all-exported-before no-more-notes) is true exactly when every note has been exported; supervisor-complete-task requires it and is the only action setting (task-completed), and all other actions require (not (task-completed)). search_notes is modeled with only access_token (page_index iteration is a runtime detail); create_file's optional overwrite is not needed. Apps are constants simple-note / file-system (hyphenated PDDL names for simple_note / file_system). No answer is required, so complete_task is called with status success and no answer.
